issues.detail: The Greek 'εκραξα' (ekraxa) is a strong verb meaning 'cried out' or 'shouted'. The Vietnamese 'đã kêu lên' (cried out) is acceptable, but the phrase 'khi đứng giữa họ' (when standing among them) is an addition/interpretation not explicitly present in the Greek text provided.
The Vietnamese translation adds 'Ấy là' (That is/It is because) at the beginning of the quote, which is not present in the Greek source.
